page_title: SAS 0-1 TOR | Sassuolo v Torino 21/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' A loose ball is pounced on by Cyril Ngonge (Torino) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Arijanet Muric is alert and makes a comfortable save.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Kristjan Asllani did his best and is replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino).
87' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Cesare Casadei (Torino) replaces Adrien Tameze.

87' Sassuolo are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cyril Ngonge (Torino) for Che Adams.
83' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

83' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Arijanet Muric makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball is out of play. Torino win a corner kick.
82' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
81' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 13:15.
79' Here is a change. Armand Lauriente is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch for Cristian Volpato.
78' The substitution has been made. Fali Cande (Sassuolo) has replaced Josh Doig.
78' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
77' The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.
76' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Calzavara had an easy-decision to make.

76' The ball is laid off to Giovanni Simeone (Torino) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Arijanet Muric to make a decent save. Torino force their opponents to concede a corner.
74' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
72' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ivan Ilic (Torino) was quite harsh and Andrea Calzavara didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' Torino couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
69' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
68' 6:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
66' 0 - 1 Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Arijanet Muric.
66' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is going to take the penalty!
65' Andrea Calzavara blows his whistle after Josh Doig (Sassuolo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Torino have been awarded a penalty kick!
64' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luca Moro (Sassuolo) is coming onto the pitch as Walid Cheddira cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) replacing Aster Vranckx.
62' Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
60' The ball is cleared after Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Duvan Zapata will be replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Torino).
58' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Gvidas Gineitis and he is replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
57' Sassuolo are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
55' 52:48 – the ratio of ball possession.
53' Golden chance! Valentino Lazaro (Torino) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
52' Torino are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
48' Sassuolo keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) was too forceful with his tackle and Andrea Calzavara interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
42' It looks like Ardian Ismajli (Torino) saw red with that tackle. Andrea Calzavara won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
40' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
38' Andrea Calzavara shows a yellow card to Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) for his blatant foul.
36' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
34' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:3.
32' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
32' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Duvan Zapata (Torino) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box.
28' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
26' Referee Andrea Calzavara seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and no action will be taken against Josh Doig (Sassuolo).
26' NO PENALTY! Referee Andrea Calzavara has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Torino players are incensed.
25' Celebrations by Torino are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
22' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Josh Doig (Sassuolo) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
22' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) brings his opponent down. Andrea Calzavara has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. The referee gives a penalty kick to Torino!!
22' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Nikola Vlasic (Torino) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Arijanet Muric easily catches the ball.
20' Andrea Calzavara interrupts the game. One of the players from Sassuolo won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
18' A spell of possession for Sassuolo in an attempt to control the game.
16' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo).
15' Sassuolo are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
13' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 55:45.
11' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
11' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
9' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
8' Andrea Calzavara has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jay Idzes (Sassuolo).
6' The linesman signals that Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
5' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) commits a rough foul. Andrea Calzavara stops the game and makes a call.
4' Torino are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
2' One of the Sassuolo players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sassuolo will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Andrea Calzavara.
